_about: The forge levels, read by level.py: the one place for every level name and requirement. One scale, 1 to 5, in four domains; a level includes every level below it. Per domain: about and about_nl (the line above its table), floor (the lowest level inside a forge project, that is where forge-work/state.json exists; left out: no floor) and its five levels. Per level: name (English), nl (Dutch), aliases (other words that mean it, lower case, either language), summary and summary_nl (one line a non-expert understands), includes (what this level adds to the one below), built_with (look only), evidence (glob patterns from the project root, ** is any folders: level.py check wants a file that holds something for each one, of this level and of every level below it), evidence_how (how that evidence comes about) and evidence_or (words: a line of the report that holds them and then the reason, in three words or more, counts in place of this level's evidence).

look.about: design, motion and 3D. Each level includes the ones below it.
look.about_nl: ontwerp, beweging en 3D. Elk niveau bevat de lagere niveaus.

levels.name: Subtle
levels.summary: Clean and calm. Every button, link and field reacts when you point at it or press it.
levels.summary_nl: Strak en rustig. Elke knop, link en elk veld reageert als je erop wijst of drukt.
includes: feedback on every control: hover, focus, press

levels.name: Polished
levels.summary: + content glides in, pages change smoothly, numbers count up, messages slide in and out.
levels.summary_nl: + inhoud schuift in beeld, pagina's wisselen vloeiend, getallen tellen op, meldingen schuiven in en uit.
includes: toasts and dialogs move in and out
levels.built_with: CSS, View Transitions, Web Animations API

levels.name: Expressive
levels.summary: + scrolling tells a story, cards tilt with real depth, charts draw themselves, one moment only this app has.
levels.summary_nl: + scrollen vertelt een verhaal, kaarten kantelen in 3D, grafieken tekenen zich, een moment dat alleen deze app heeft.
includes: scroll storytelling: reveals, sticky scenes, parallax layers
real depth with CSS 3D: tilting cards, layered panels, perspective
one signature moment built for this app only
levels.built_with: + CSS 3D, scroll-driven animation; scenes/depth.js of the scene kit

levels.name: Showpiece
levels.summary: + a living 3D scene made for this app that follows your pointer, and 3D cards, objects and charts.
levels.summary_nl: + een levende 3D-scene voor deze app die je aanwijzer volgt, en kaarten, objecten en grafieken in 3D.
includes: a WebGL hero scene made for this app's concept: a generative form, a particle field, a shader atmosphere or a contour field
3D inside the interface: cards, objects, charts
Three.js installed without asking again (npm, local, never a CDN), loaded lazily and only on the screens that use it
a still poster for weak devices, for no WebGL and for reduced motion

levels.name: Cinematic
levels.summary: + a 3D journey as you scroll, like a film; the forms react to you and to the app's live data.
levels.summary_nl: + een 3D-reis bij het scrollen, als een film; de vormen reageren op jou en op de live data van de app.
includes: a scroll-driven 3D journey: a camera that moves through chapters
forms that react to the pointer and to the app's live data

dashboard.about: how rich the dashboard on the app's own data is. Each level includes the ones below it.
dashboard.about_nl: hoe rijk het dashboard op de eigen data van de app is. Elk niveau bevat de lagere niveaus.

levels.name: Subtle
levels.summary: Calm: 3 to 5 key numbers, one chart and one table.
levels.summary_nl: Rustig: 3 tot 5 kerncijfers, een grafiek en een tabel.

levels.name: Polished
levels.summary: + tiles with the change and a small trend line, 2 or 3 charts, a period filter, every state designed.
levels.summary_nl: + tegels met het verschil en een kleine trendlijn, 2 of 3 grafieken, een periodefilter, elke toestand ontworpen.

levels.name: Expressive
levels.summary: + charts that draw in and morph, click through to detail, compare periods, a heat map, live refresh.
levels.summary_nl: + grafieken die zich tekenen en vervormen, doorklikken, periodes vergelijken, een heatmap, live bijwerken.
includes: charts that draw in and morph between periods
a value matrix or heat map

levels.name: Showpiece
levels.summary: + a dense control-room screen: live readouts, linked panels, one crosshair over all charts, charts with depth.
levels.summary_nl: + een vol controlekamerscherm: live meetwaarden, gekoppelde panelen, een kruisdraad over alle grafieken, met diepte.

levels.name: Cinematic
levels.summary: + your data as a 3D landscape, the camera moves when you filter; a plain table stays one key away.
levels.summary_nl: + je data als 3D-landschap, de camera beweegt als je filtert; een gewone tabel blijft een toets weg.
includes: a WebGL data scene: the app's own data as a 3D field (scenes/datascape.js of the scene kit)
the camera moves when a filter changes
a plain table of the same data is always one key press away

test.about: how deep the testing goes. Each level includes the ones below it.
test.about_nl: hoe diep het testen gaat. Elk niveau bevat de lagere niveaus.

levels.name: Quick
levels.summary: The app starts, the main flow works once, no error in the browser console. Takes minutes.
levels.summary_nl: De app start, de belangrijkste flow werkt een keer, geen fout in de browserconsole. Duurt minuten.

levels.name: Basic
levels.summary: + every user flow tested the way it should go, plus unit tests for the logic that matters.
levels.summary_nl: + elke gebruikersflow getest zoals het hoort te gaan, plus unittests voor de logica die telt.
includes: unit tests for the logic that matters

levels.name: Standard
levels.summary: + wrong and odd input, every page walked at 3 widths in light and dark, no user sees another's data.
levels.summary_nl: + foute en vreemde invoer, elke pagina bekeken op 3 breedtes in licht en donker, geen gebruiker ziet andermans data.
includes: the walk: every page, 3 widths, light and dark (errors, links, axe, layout, speed)
levels.evidence_how: Run the walk of forge-check test (its walk spec): it writes this file after every page.

levels.name: Thorough
levels.summary: + every form with empty, long and odd input, speed limits, screenshots compared, offline, keyboard only.
levels.summary_nl: + elk formulier met lege, lange en vreemde invoer, snelheidsgrenzen, schermen vergeleken, offline, alleen toetsenbord.
includes: the edge helpers on every form
levels.evidence_how: Write the edge spec from forge-check's edge example, one group per form. Walk twice: FORGE_ROUND=r1, and FORGE_ROUND=r2 after the fixes. Each round keeps its own screenshots.

levels.name: Exhaustive
levels.summary: + every page in every state, hostile and huge input, two tabs, time zones, slow networks, all run 3 times.
levels.summary_nl: + elke pagina in elke toestand, vijandige en enorme invoer, twee tabbladen, tijdzones, trage netwerken, alles 3 keer.
includes: hostile and oversized input on every field (own app only)
each spec run three times to catch flakes

secure.about: how deep the security check goes. Each level includes the ones below it.
secure.about_nl: hoe diep de beveiligingscontrole gaat. Elk niveau bevat de lagere niveaus.

levels.name: Quick
levels.summary: Leaked secrets and risky code. Only on its own, never inside a forge project.
levels.summary_nl: Gelekte geheimen en riskante code. Alleen los, nooit binnen een forge-project.
includes: only on its own, never as a forge phase

levels.name: Basic
levels.summary: + known holes in the app's packages, the site's security headers, trackers. Also only on its own.
levels.summary_nl: + bekende lekken in de pakketten van de app, de beveiligingsheaders van de site, trackers. Ook alleen los.

levels.name: Standard
levels.summary: + input traced to risky code, package origins, framework checks, AVG/GDPR, OWASP. The least in a forge project.
levels.summary_nl: + invoer gevolgd tot riskante code, herkomst van pakketten, framework-checks, AVG, OWASP. Minimum in een forge-project.
includes: the floor inside a forge project: the secure phase never runs below this level
levels.evidence_how: Run supply.py with --sbom forge-work/sbom.json: it writes the list of every locked package.

levels.name: Thorough
levels.summary: + your running app probed, two users tried on each other's data, semgrep, container checks.
levels.summary_nl: + je draaiende app afgetast, twee gebruikers op elkaars data geprobeerd, semgrep, container-controles.
includes: the active probe on the running app (own app only)
the two-user access check on the running app (own app only)
levels.evidence_how: Run probe.py and authz.py with --json on the user's own running app, and save what each prints in its file.

levels.name: Exhaustive
levels.summary: + a threat model per way in, every route against every role, abuse limits, secrets in old commits, attack stories.
levels.summary_nl: + een dreigingsmodel per ingang, elke route tegen elke rol, misbruiklimieten, geheimen in oude commits, aanvalsverhalen.
includes: a threat model per entry point by reading the code: auth, session, payment, upload
an access matrix of every route against every role
a scan of the git history for secrets
each finding with the attack told as a story
